chunks: Say: 'Intercession belongs entirely to God; His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth; then to Him you will be returned.'
ai.seo_question: Who has the power of intercession according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the principle of 'shafa'ah bi-idhnillah' (intercession by God's permission), clarifying that while the Ahl al-Bayt and prophets act as intercessors, their authority is derived entirely from Allah's sovereignty. It underscores the monotheistic core of Shia theology, where divine judgment is the ultimate reality, and intercession is a mercy granted by the King of the Heavens and Earth.
